build_avatar_url.description: Turn a seed into the address of an avatar in any of DiceBear's styles: pixel art, illustrated faces, robots, initials, identicons, abstract shapes. The same seed always gives the same avatar, so a user id or an email address becomes a profile picture that stays put. Nothing is downloaded, so this is the cheap way to fill an empty avatar slot, give a record a picture or put a face beside a name in an email. Leave the seed blank for a random avatar. No API key required.
build_avatar_url.display_str_template: Build a DiceBear avatar URL in the {0} style.
build_avatar_url.name: build_avatar_url

parameters.description: Which avatar style to draw in, as DiceBear names it: lower case with hyphens, such as pixel-art, lorelei or adventurer-neutral. Pick one from the list, which is fetched from DiceBear, or type a name. The styles come from different artists under different licences; List avatar styles shows every one with its creator and licence.
parameters.name: style

parameters.description: Optional. The text the avatar is drawn from: a user id, an email address, a name, anything at all. The same seed always gives the same avatar and a different seed a different one, so pass whatever identifies the person or thing the avatar stands for. Leave it blank and a random seed is drawn and reported, for a fresh avatar every run. The seed travels in the link, so hash an email address first if that matters.
parameters.name: seed

parameters.description: Optional. The file format. SVG by default, which scales to any size and is what DiceBear recommends. PNG, JPEG, WebP and AVIF are rendered at 128 pixels unless a size is given and at most 256, and DiceBear allows fewer requests a second for them.
parameters.name: image_format

parameters.description: Optional. The avatar's width and height in pixels. Left blank, an SVG scales to wherever it is shown and a raster image is 128 pixels. An SVG takes anything up to 4096; PNG, JPEG, WebP and AVIF take at most 256, which is the largest DiceBear renders.
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: Optional. One or more background colours as hex, with or without the #, separated by commas: b6e3f4 for one colour, b6e3f4,c0aede,d1d4f9 to let the seed pick one of three, which keeps a long list of avatars varied but on brand. Left blank, the style draws its own background, transparent for most of them.
parameters.name: background_color

parameters.description: Optional. How the background colours are painted: one solid colour, which is the default, or a linear or radial gradient between them. A gradient needs at least two colours to blend.
parameters.name: background_fill

parameters.description: Optional. How rounded the avatar's corners are, as a percentage from 0 to 50. 0 by default, which is a square; 50 is a circle, the usual choice for a profile picture.
parameters.name: border_radius

parameters.description: Optional. Turn the whole avatar by this many degrees, from -360 to 360. 0 by default.
parameters.name: rotate

parameters.description: Optional. Grow or shrink the drawing inside its frame, where 1 is the avatar's own size, 0.8 leaves a margin round it and 1.2 crops the edges. Anything from 0 to 10.
parameters.name: scale

parameters.description: Optional. Mirror the avatar left to right, turn it upside down, or both. No flip by default.
parameters.name: flip

parameters.description: Optional. The style's own options, by name: which hairstyles to pick from (hairVariant: short01,short02), whether to draw glasses (glassesProbability: 0), which skin colours to use (skinColor: f2d3b1,ecad80). Separate several values with commas, and add :weight to a variant to make it more likely. Get style options lists every option a style takes, as does its page on dicebear.com. The seed, size, flip, rotation, scale, corner radius and background have fields of their own.

list_styles.description: List every avatar style DiceBear offers, with who drew it, the artwork it is based on, the licence it is under and a preview. The names come from DiceBear itself, so a style added upstream shows up here. Read this to offer someone the choice, to pick a style by name, or to print the credit a CC BY style asks for wherever its avatars are shown. Keep only the characters, the minimalist styles or the scenes. No API key required.

description: Turn any seed into an avatar with DiceBear, the free open-source avatar library: give it a user id, an email address or a name and get back a picture in any of sixty-odd styles, from pixel art, illustrated faces and robots to initials, identicons and abstract shapes. The same seed always gives the same avatar, which is what makes it the stand-in for a profile picture nobody has uploaded yet. Build a link to embed, build a whole list of them for a team in one step, download the picture as a file, inline it as a data URI, or read the SVG and every choice the generator made. Every style comes with its creator and licence. No account or API key required.
